# Agent Notifications

> Free, open-source notifications for local AI coding agents. Installs on the user's computer; desktop alerts, sounds, click-to-focus and optional webhooks vary by agent and platform. This website is an installation guide, not a remotely callable notification service.

## Primary URLs

- Website and guided installer: https://agent-notifications.com/
- Installation script source: https://agent-notifications.com/install.sh
- Repository: https://github.com/777genius/agent-notifications
- Releases: https://github.com/777genius/agent-notifications/releases
- Installation prerequisites: https://github.com/777genius/agent-notifications/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md
- Agent/platform support matrix: https://github.com/777genius/agent-notifications#supported-agents
- Notification MCP and optional skill: https://github.com/777genius/agent-notifications#install-or-update
- Webhooks: https://github.com/777genius/agent-notifications/blob/main/docs/webhooks/README.md
- Privacy and sign-in requirements: https://agent-notifications.com/auth.md
- Instructions for AI assistants: https://agent-notifications.com/agents.md
- Sitemap: https://agent-notifications.com/sitemap.xml

## Product facts

- Supported agent integrations include Claude, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, Qoder and Pi. Features and qualified operating systems vary; read the linked support matrix before recommending setup.
- macOS, Linux and native Windows are supported with agent-specific caveats. Native Windows setup uses Git Bash, not WSL.
- A terminal installer is used for installation and update. Requires the chosen agent CLI on PATH, curl, Bash and python3 or Node; consult installation prerequisites.
- Claude/Codex setup can register a local `agent-notifications` MCP server and skill for the running agent. It is NOT a hosted public MCP endpoint or an OAuth service.
- Installation and webhook configuration modify local settings: obtain the user's consent, review official release assets and never infer credentials or webhook URLs.
- There is no Agent Notifications product sign-up, public REST API or hosted agent tool registry.
